lines.en: label day239:
scene black
I open the door and move out into the hallway.
lines.zh: 我打开门，走到走廊上。

lines.en: It’s cold today.
lines.zh: 今天很冷。

lines.en: Granted, it’s cold pretty much every day now on account of that whole “Winter” thing-
lines.zh: 当然，因为「冬天」那档子事，现在基本每天都冷——

lines.en: But it feels even colder than it’s supposed to be, if you know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: 但今天比该有的温度还要更冷，如果你懂我意思的话。

lines.en: It’s that weird temperature where your clothes seem two sizes tighter than normal and any residual moisture on your hair only slightly-freezes instead of getting completely hard.
lines.zh: 就是那种诡异的温度：衣服好像比平时紧了两个码，头发上残留的水汽只是微微结冰，而不是彻底冻硬。

lines.en: It’s a special kind of coldness.
lines.zh: 这是一种特别的冷。

lines.en: It somehow sneaks in through closed windows and air vents, turning this once-warm sanctuary of sorts into a frozen hellscape.
lines.zh: 它不知怎么就透过紧闭的窗户和通风口钻进来，把这个曾经还算温暖的避难所变成了冰封地狱。

lines.en: And there’s someone I know who reminds me a lot of that very specific and particular feeling.
lines.zh: 而我认识的某个人，总让我想起这种非常具体、非常特别的感受。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta1
: Hey.
: Yo.
: Why are you just standing with your back to the window like you're trapped in some sort of game CG?
lines.zh: : 你怎么背对着窗户站着，像是被困在什么游戏的 CG 里？

lines.en: : There’s something I felt the two of us should discuss.
lines.zh: : 有件事我觉得我们两个该谈一谈。

lines.en: : We haven’t had a substantial conversation since Christmas, and as much as I love that, I can’t go on perpetually ignoring the situation.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节之后我们就没好好说过话了，虽然我很享受这一点，但我不能一直这么无视现状下去。

lines.en: : Are you...confessing to me?
lines.zh: : 你这是……在跟我表白？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta2
: Uhh, what? No. Not even close.
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？不是。差远了。

lines.en: : Worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 值得一试嘛。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta3
: It’s about our last meeting on the roof. And how the strange level of confidence I had that night bore no fruit whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 是关于我们上次在天台的那次见面。还有那天晚上我那股莫名其妙的自信，最后完全没有结果。

lines.en: : And what better place to talk about something as serious as that than a hallway full of students, right?
lines.zh: : 谈这么严肃的事，还有比挤满学生的走廊更合适的地方吗，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta4
: High school girls are kind of like snow- beautiful, yet fleeting.
lines.zh: : 高中女生有点像雪——美丽，却转瞬即逝。

lines.en: : Before you know it, they're gone.
lines.zh: : 你还没反应过来，她们就消失了。

lines.en: : Look around you. What do you see?
lines.zh: : 看看你周围。你看到了什么？

lines.en: I turn around to find the same strangers as always, passing by and paying little to no attention.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看到的还是那一如既往的陌生人，来来往往，几乎毫不在意。

lines.en: I can’t help but think about the horrible things I would do to some of them if given the opportunity, but for now they’re all just-
lines.zh: 我忍不住想象，要是有机会，我会对其中一些人做出多么可怕的事，但目前她们都只是——

lines.en: : Empty...
lines.zh: : 空洞……

lines.en: scene mayaanduta5
: Careful. Your thoughts seem to be spilling out of your head.
lines.zh: : 小心点。你的想法好像正从脑子里溢出来。

lines.en: : Something like that could prove extremely detrimental to your “career.”
lines.zh: : 这种话万一被人听见，对你的「职业生涯」可是极其不利的。

lines.en: : Do you see what I’m saying now, though?
lines.zh: : 那么，你现在明白我的意思了吗？

lines.en: : That no one is paying any attention and that even if they overheard our conversation they probably wouldn’t think anything of it?
lines.zh: : 没人注意我们，就算听见了我们的对话，大概也不会多想？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta6
: Oh, wow. You actually do.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。你还真明白。

lines.en: : Color me surprised.
lines.zh: : 我可真是吃了一惊。

lines.en: : So, what’s going on? Are you trying to blame this[school] thing on our rooftop-meeting?
lines.zh: : 所以，到底怎么了？你是想把这所[school]的事怪到我们那次天台会面上？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta7
: That’s just the thing...
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿……

lines.en: : Things have changed before but...never like this.
lines.zh: : 以前也变过，但……从没像这样。

lines.en: : An everlasting[school] year filled with the same old faces and the same old seating arrangements-
lines.zh: : 一个永远不结束的[school]学年，全是一成不变的面孔、一成不变的座位安排——

lines.en: : That’s all I’ve had for god-knows how long at this point.
lines.zh: : 天知道从什么时候起，我拥有的就只有这些了。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be excited that you get to see something new then?
lines.zh: : 那能见到点新东西，你不是该高兴吗？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta8
: I believe I’ve made it very apparent that anything new is not ideal for me.
lines.zh: : 我想我已经表现得很清楚了，任何新事物对我来说都不理想。

lines.en: : This also makes me sound like a bit of an idiot- spouting all of those things about how life is a cycle only to have something like this go and happen just shortly after.
lines.zh: : 这也显得我像个傻子——刚说完人生是个循环那一套，转头就发生了这种事。

lines.en: : Sounds like a pretty intense inner-struggle you’ve got going on there.
lines.zh: : 听起来你内心斗争得挺激烈啊。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta9
: Yup.
I want to say more to comfort Maya but...
lines.zh: 我想多说几句安慰 Maya，但……

lines.en: Well, I’m pretty sure that I’m even lower on the list of things that would calm her than having a cavity drilled or having to bury a child.
lines.zh: 嗯，我很确定，在能让她平静下来的东西里，我的排名比钻牙、比埋葬一个孩子还要低。

lines.en: That second one may be a bit of a stretch, but what I’m essentially saying is that there isn’t anything I can do for her.
lines.zh: 后一个可能有点夸张，但我想说的本质上是：我帮不了她什么。

lines.en: Or, at least I don’t think there is.
lines.zh: 或者，至少我觉得帮不了。

lines.en: And I’ll probably always think that since, even now, in her most vulnerable or...confused (?) moments, she’s still miles away from me.
lines.zh: 而且我大概永远都会这么想，因为即便是现在，在她最脆弱、或者说最……困惑（？）的时刻，她离我依然有千里之遥。

lines.en: : Like I was saying, I don’t expect you to do anything. Or even care, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我没指望你做什么。甚至也没指望你在乎。

lines.en: : I just thought it would only be right to inform you that...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，至少应该告诉你一声……

lines.en: : I might not know what’s coming next.
lines.zh: : 我可能不知道接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta10
: But, then again, this could all just be some sort of hiccup.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，这也可能只是个小插曲。

lines.en: : A glitch in the matrix, if you will.
lines.zh: : 可以说是母体里的一个故障。

lines.en: : It’s very possible that everything will go back to normal in the middle of the season, the way it’s done so many times before.
lines.zh: : 很有可能一切会在这一季的中途恢复正常，就像以前发生过那么多次一样。

lines.en: : And you’ll have to say goodbye to whoever your next prey may be.
lines.zh: : 到时候你就得跟下一个猎物道别了。

lines.en: : How come you always need to make me sound like some sort of predator?
lines.zh: : 你怎么总是要把我说得像个捕食者？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta11
: Is that an actual question? Because I’ve got a pretty drawn-out response in the event that it is.
lines.zh: : 这算是个正经问题吗？如果是的话，我可有一段相当长的回答。

lines.en: : You can tell me the whole thing on the way home if you want.
lines.zh: : 想说的话，回家路上你可以慢慢跟我说。

lines.en: : I’m not going home with you. This is exactly why I called you a predator.
lines.zh: : 我不会跟你回家。我管你叫捕食者就是这个原因。

lines.en: : And even if I was, that wouldn't be enough time.
lines.zh: : 而且就算我跟你回去，那段路也不够长。

lines.en: : At least come downstairs with me, then. I’ve already been spending too much time here lately and I want to get out as quickly as I can.
lines.zh: : 那至少陪我下楼吧。我最近在这儿待的时间已经够多了，想尽快出去。

lines.en: : I suppose I can walk downstairs with you since I also need to do that in order to leave.
lines.zh: : 我想我可以陪你走下楼，反正我要走也得下楼。

lines.en: : Then it’s a date.
lines.zh: : 那就是约会了。

lines.en: : It most certainly is not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。

lines.en: scene black
Maya and I leave the third floor, the one we spend roughly one-third of our lives on, and head toward the lockers.
lines.zh: 我和 Maya 离开三楼——那层我们大概要耗掉三分之一人生的地方——朝储物柜走去。

lines.en: The snow- Err, the students that crowded the hall just minutes ago have mostly dispersed, leaving several stragglers behind amidst puddles of dirty water in front of the entrance.
lines.zh: 几分钟前还挤满走廊的雪——呃，学生——大多已经散去，只剩几个掉队的，站在入口前那一摊摊脏水里。

lines.en: Or exit, in some cases.
lines.zh: 某些情况下，那也是出口。

lines.en: A door that people move through.
lines.zh: 一扇供人穿行的门。

lines.en: Let’s just call it that.
lines.zh: 就这么叫吧。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta12
: You didn’t have to stop at my locker, you know.
lines.zh: : 你其实不用在我储物柜前停下来的。

lines.en: : Sorry, I wanted to know where I should be dropping off the love-letter I’ve been writing to you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是想知道我一直在给你写的那封情书该投在哪儿。

lines.en: : I think it would reach me best if you’d just toss it into the nearest active fireplace.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你直接扔进最近的壁炉里，我能收到得最清楚。

lines.en: : Speaking of active fireplaces-
lines.zh: : 说到烧着的壁炉——

lines.en: : What can you possibly be segueing into with that?
lines.zh: : 你究竟想靠这个转到什么话题上去？

lines.en: : Is it really possible for things to go back to normal again after the next reset?
lines.zh: : 下一次重置之后，事情真的还能恢复正常吗？

lines.en: : Oh, something completely unrelated to fireplaces. That’s on-brand.
lines.zh: : 哦，跟壁炉完全无关的话题。这很符合你的风格。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta13
: I’m not sure...
lines.zh: : 我不确定……

lines.en: : The city itself is unfazed by all of the time-skips, it seems.
lines.zh: : 城市本身似乎并不受那些时间跳跃的影响。

lines.en: : It’s the same reason new buildings keep popping up- and how the weather still changes.
lines.zh: : 这也是为什么新楼会不断冒出来——天气也照样在变。

lines.en: : How I imagine it will work if it does go back to normal-
lines.zh: : 如果真要恢复正常，我猜过程会是这样的——

lines.en: : No, when it goes back to normal- is that the second[school] will go up again and, before long, everyone will filter back in.
lines.zh: : 不，是当它恢复正常的时候——第二所[school]会重新盖起来，用不了多久，大家就都会陆陆续续回来。

lines.en: : Think of it like buying a new tank and filling it with fish.
lines.zh: : 可以想象成买个新鱼缸，然后往里放鱼。

lines.en: : Why do we always need a metaphor? I understood what you meant the first time.
lines.zh: : 我们为什么总是要打比方？我第一遍就听懂了。

lines.en: : I like metaphors.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢比喻。

lines.en: : They’re one of the few things that make everything seem more real.
lines.zh: : 比喻是少数能让一切都显得更真实的东西之一。

lines.en: She’s right about that, at least.
lines.zh: 至少这一点她说对了。

lines.en: Well, not the metaphor part. The part about how this doesn’t feel real.
lines.zh: 嗯，不是比喻那部分。是「这一切感觉不真实」那部分。

lines.en: Which is a strange thing for me to say given that nothing about this place is real...
lines.zh: 考虑到这地方没有一样东西是真实的，我这么说还挺奇怪的……

lines.en: But...how can I say this?
lines.zh: 但是……该怎么说呢？

lines.en: A[school] sinking into the ground and everyone having to transfer here? That’s just ridiculous.
lines.zh: 一所[school]沉进地里，所有人不得不转到这里来？这太荒唐了。

lines.en: Things like that don’t happen.
lines.zh: 这种事不会发生。

lines.en: Entire[school]s don’t fall into the ground.
lines.zh: 整所[school]是不会塌进地里的。

lines.en: But I guess when you don’t know what’s beneath you-
lines.zh: 不过我想，当你不知道自己脚下是什么的时候——

lines.en: scene mayaanduta14
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Is that...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : Ooooookay, let’s see here...Building A...West entrance...
lines.zh: : 好——嘞，让我看看……A 栋……西入口……

lines.en: : Yup! This is the place!
lines.zh: : 没错！就是这儿！

lines.en: : Onward to a new path in life!
lines.zh: : 向着人生新的道路前进！

lines.en: : Give ‘em Hell, Ushibori!
lines.zh: : 给他们点颜色看看，Ushibori！

lines.en: scene mayaanduta15
: Oh god...No way.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪……不会吧。

lines.en: : What’s going on? That voice sounds familiar.
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？那声音听着耳熟。

lines.en: Wasn’t Ushibori the last name of the girl transferring into my class? I wonder if-
lines.zh: Ushibori 不就是要转进我班上那个女生的姓吗？我在想会不会——

lines.en: : Ah! Not even two steps into my new[school] and I’m already seeing friendly faces!
lines.zh: : 啊！刚踏进新[school]还没两步，就看到熟面孔了！

lines.en: scene mayaanduta16

lines.zh: : Uta？……

lines.en: : You’re...going to[school] here now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在要在这所[school]上学了？

lines.en: : You know it, prin-
lines.zh: : 那当然，公——

lines.en: : Don’t call me that.
lines.zh: : 别那么叫我。

lines.en: : You know it, Maya!
lines.zh: : 那当然，Maya！

lines.en: scene mayaanduta17
: And you’re here, too! I knew you two went to this[school] but I had no idea I’d be running into you so soon!
lines.zh: : 而且你也在！我知道你们俩在这所[school]上学，但没想到这么快就撞上了！

lines.en: : Hey, hey! You wouldn’t happen to be Mr. Arakawa, would you? Cause that’s Ami’s last name and...by process of elimination...
lines.zh: : 嘿，嘿！您该不会就是 Arakawa 先生吧？因为 Ami 也姓这个，而且……排除法嘛……

lines.en: Uta-chan is going to be in my class.
lines.zh: Uta 要进我的班了。

lines.en: I’ve never been more thankful for so many people losing their jobs.
lines.zh: 我从来没有像现在这样，感激这么多人丢了工作。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta18
: And of course she’s in our class...
lines.zh: : 她当然是在我们班……

lines.en: : Welcome to the class, Uta. Looks like I’m going to be your new teacher.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到班上，Uta。看来我要当你的新老师了。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta19
: Really!? Like, really-really?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗！？就是，真真真的吗！？

lines.en: : Please take good care of me, then!
lines.zh: : 那请您多多关照啦！

lines.en: : I will protect you as if my life depends on it.
lines.zh: : 我会拼了命保护你的。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta20
: Don’t protect me too much though, okay?
lines.zh: : 不过也别保护过头了哦？

lines.en: : We don’t want your girlfriend here getting jealous, do we?
lines.zh: : 我们可不想让这位女朋友吃醋，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta21
: You’re way off, Uta...
lines.zh: : 你差得远了，Uta……

lines.en: : Like, all the way off.
lines.zh: : 差到十万八千里去了。

lines.en: : Oh, please. First you two show up at a maid cafe together...then you ask me to keep it a secret from Ami...
lines.zh: : 哎呀拜托。你们俩先是一起出现在女仆咖啡店……然后又让我对 Ami 保密……

lines.en: : And now you’re hanging out at the lockers together? Bold move, you two. Bold move.
lines.zh: : 现在又一起在储物柜这儿腻着？胆子真大，你们俩。胆子真大。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta22
: Your secret's safe with me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我会替你们保密的。

lines.en: : My dad is like 15 years older than my mom, so I get it. Sometimes you’ve just gotta grab ‘em while they’re still [young]or-
lines.zh: : 我爸比我妈大了差不多十五岁，所以我懂。有时候就是得趁她们还[young]的时候先下手为强——

lines.en: : Okay, I’m leaving now.
lines.zh: : 好了，我走了。

lines.en: : Please don’t follow me.
lines.zh: : 别跟过来。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta23
Maya grabs her things out of her locker and makes for the door without giving Uta or myself a second glance.
lines.zh: Maya 从储物柜里抓出自己的东西，朝门口走去，连一眼都没再看 Uta 或我。

lines.en: I watch her put a green scarf on as she disappears into the snow.
lines.zh: 我看着她围上一条绿色围巾，消失在雪里。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta24
: Just to let you know, I probs can’t call you Master in[school]. I think that would get both of us in lots of trouble.
lines.zh: : 先跟您说一声，在[school]里我大概不能叫您 Master 了。我觉得那样会给我们俩惹来大麻烦。

lines.en: : You can call me whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么叫都行。

lines.en: : Okay, Maya’s boyfriend!
lines.zh: : 好的，Maya 的男朋友！

lines.en: : Uhh, maybe not anything, actually.
lines.zh: : 呃，好吧，其实也不是什么都能叫。

lines.en: : I know how it looks but the two of us really aren’t like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道看着像那么回事，但我们俩真不是那种关系。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta25
: Really? Well that’s good, at least.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那至少还挺好的。

lines.en: : Cause...this might sound kinda weird, but I’m pretty sure Ami has the hots for you.
lines.zh: : 因为……这话听着可能有点怪，但我敢肯定 Ami 对您有意思。

lines.en: : Can you imagine the drama that would spark up if you were dating her best friend?
lines.zh: : 您要是跟她最好的朋友交往，那得闹出多大的戏啊，您能想象吗？

lines.en: scene mayaanduta26
: But it is what it is! I’m just super excited to have somebody I know as my teacher!
lines.zh: : 不过该怎样就怎样！反正有个认识的人当我的老师，我超开心的！

lines.en: : I’ll be a good girl in class, okay? You won’t even know I’m there.
lines.zh: : 我在班上会乖乖的，好不好？您甚至都不会感觉到我在那儿。

lines.en: : Oh and if you could like, never call on me for any science question...or math question...
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，您能不能就是……别点我回答理科问题……或者数学问题……

lines.en: : Or Japanese question...or English question...
lines.zh: : 或者国语问题……或者英语问题……

lines.en: Is there anything I can call on her for?
lines.zh: 那还有什么我能点她的？

lines.en: Wait, I don’t ever call on anyone for anything.
lines.zh: 等等，我根本从来不点任何人回答任何问题啊。

lines.en: : Let me stop you right there and inform you that your life is about to get immensely easier.
lines.zh: : 我先打断你一下，顺便告诉你，你的日子马上就要轻松太多了。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta27
: Easier? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 轻松？什么意思？

lines.en: : You’re not gonna try and propose one of those “I scratch your back, you scratch mine” things, are you? Cause I’m supposed to let my parents know whenever I start doing that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 您该不会是想跟我提那种「你帮我挠背、我帮你挠背」的交易吧？因为我要是开始做那种事，得先跟爸妈说一声。

lines.en: : Also you’re like a billion times my size. It's kind of intimidating, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 而且您的个头是我的十亿倍大。说实话，还挺吓人的。

lines.en: : As thrilled as I am to hear that those are the only two barriers to entry-
lines.zh: : 听到入门障碍只有这两条，我是挺高兴的——

lines.en: scene mayaanduta28
: Three counting your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 算上您女朋友就是三条。

lines.en: : Three counting the girlfriend who is not my girlfriend-
lines.zh: : 三条，算上那个不是我女朋友的女朋友——

lines.en: : Or so he says.
lines.zh: : 他自己是这么说的。

lines.en: : What I mean is that I’ll basically just let you do whatever you want in class.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我在课上基本会让你想干什么就干什么。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta29
: Aww, that’s so sweet of you...But you really don’t have to give me special treatment just because I’m a super cute maid by night.
lines.zh: : 哇，您人真好……不过您真的不用因为我晚上是个超可爱的女仆就给我特殊待遇啦。

lines.en: : I promise I’ll work just as hard for you in the cafe even if you work me to the bone in[school].
lines.zh: : 我保证，就算您在[school]里把我使唤到骨头散架，我在咖啡店里也会一样拼命为您干活。

lines.en: : It’s not special treatment. I do the same thing for everyone.
lines.zh: : 这不是特殊待遇。我对所有人都这样。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta30
: And you still get to keep your job?!
lines.zh: : 这样您居然还能保住工作！？

lines.en: : Surprisingly, yes.
lines.zh: : 挺意外的，确实还能。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta31
: AHHHHH THIS SCHOOL IS ALREADY SO MUCH FRIGGIN’ BETTER!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊这所学校已经好他妈的太多了！

lines.en: scene mayaanduta32
: Hey! Umm, I don’t know if it was just some lame rumor going around but...do I really get to stay in a dorm?
lines.zh: : 嘿！呃，我不知道那是不是什么无聊的传闻，但是……我真的可以住宿舍吗？

lines.en: : Cause if that’s true, I’m gonna flip out.
lines.zh: : 因为如果那是真的，我就要疯了。

lines.en: : Did they really not tell you anything about how it works here?
lines.zh: : 他们真的一点都没跟你说这儿是怎么运作的？

lines.en: : I’m on my way to talk to the principal about all that stuff now, but you can spoil the surprise for me if you want.
lines.zh: : 我现在正要去跟校长谈这些事，不过您要是想提前剧透，我也没关系。

lines.en: : In fact, please spoil me. I need to know.
lines.zh: : 说真的，请务必剧透我。我必须知道。

lines.en: : Unless they changed something, yes, you’ll get to stay in a dorm.
lines.zh: : 除非他们改了规定，是的，你可以住宿舍。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta31
: THIS IS SO HECKIN’ AWESOME OH MY GOD!
lines.zh: : 这简直太他妈的棒了，我的天哪！

lines.en: scene mayaanduta32
: Sensei!...which I guess is my new name for you when I’m not in uniform-
lines.zh: : Sensei！……我想我不穿制服的时候就该这么叫您——

lines.en: : I’m gonna go to my meeting thingy now. But I’ll see you in class tomorrow, right?! Right?!
lines.zh: : 我现在要去开那个会了。明天课上见，对吧？！对吧？！

lines.en: : You certainly will.
lines.zh: : 当然会见。

lines.en: : Have fun at your “meeting thingy.”
lines.zh: : 祝你那个「会」开得开心。

lines.en: scene mayaanduta31
: I’LL HAVE SO MUCH FUN, YOU WON’T EVEN UNDERSTAND IT!
lines.zh: : 我会开心到您根本理解不了的程度！

lines.en: scene mayaanduta33
Uta sprints down the hallway (And the wrong one, might I add) and I already don’t understand how much fun she’s having.
lines.zh: Uta 沿着走廊一路狂奔（而且跑错了方向，容我补充一句），而我已经无法理解她到底有多开心了。

lines.en: The last thing my class needs is another loud and obnoxious girl, but...
lines.zh: 我的班最不需要的就是再来一个又吵又闹的女生，但是……

lines.en: I will gladly make an exception for Uta.
lines.zh: 但我很乐意为 Uta 破例。

lines.en: scene black
In fact, I’d probably kill for her if she asked me to.
lines.zh: 事实上，如果她开口，我大概会为她去杀人。

lines.en: That’s an incredibly dangerous thing to admit, but...
lines.zh: 承认这种话危险得要命，但是……

lines.en: I’m pretty sure it might actually be true.
lines.zh: 我很确定，这也许是真的。

lines.en: I guess the Uta I know isn’t the same one I’ll be seeing every day from now on, but still-
lines.zh: 我想，我认识的那个 Uta 和我从今往后每天要见的那个并不是同一个人，但即便如此——

lines.en: She seems lively and friendly enough that the two of us will get along great once we get to spend some time together...
lines.zh: 她看起来足够活泼、足够友善，等我们相处一段时间，一定会处得很好……

lines.en: $ uta_love += 1
$ day239 = True
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
lines.zh: Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]！
